notes.title: Season 1 Patch Notes Released
notes.content:
On 24 September 2025 at 06:00 (UTC), we applied balance adjustments and bug fixes.

　
[hr][/hr]
　
Buffs
　

　
・Frieza (First Form)
　　
Skills1 Show Them, Zarbon!
・Cooldown time reduced: 30→20 seconds

・Cooldown reduction based on Zarbon's remaining HP upon retreat increased: 60–40→80–40%

・Time to reach maximum range reduced: 5→3 seconds

・Effect of “Strike Defense Down” applied to enemies reduced: 100→50

　
Skills 3: Imperial Decree
・Increased boost speed when Dodoria is enhanced: 200% → 250%

・Increased attack interval reduction when Zarbon is enhanced: 40% → 60%

　　

　
・Piccolo
　
Skills 1: Light Grenade
・Cooldown time reduced: 20→15 seconds

・Damage dealt increased: 2520/2800/3360→3000/3280/3560

　　
Super Attack:Special Beam Cannon
・Maximum Charge Time Reduction: 4→3 seconds

　　

　
・Son Goku (Mini)
　　
Rush Attack
・Damage Increase: 33→41

　　　　
[hr][/hr]
　　　
Bug Fixes
　　

・Fixed an issue where the effect of “Frieza (First Form)”‘s Passive 'Fearsome Emperor’ could be interrupted by ally healing or contact with areas generated by himself or allies.

・Fixed an issue where skills targeting enemies or allies would activate without a valid target right before switching to GEKISHIN Burst.

・Fixed an issue where Zen-Oh would disappear if a triple KO occurred right before he returned to his starting point.

・Fixed an issue where Dragon Ball didn't display correctly when obtained.

　　　
[hr][/hr]
　　

We appreciate your continued support of “DRAGON BALL GEKISHIN SQUADRA”.

notes.title: The Official Launch of DRAGON BALL GEKISHIN SQUADRA Is Here!
notes.content:
SQUAD UP, BEAT DOWN!Dragon Ball's First 4vs4 Team Battle is Here!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138710/4f7f633bfc250114f2e9b9859f5f43a1e652d6df.jpg"]
[p align="justify"]Bandai Namco Entertainment Inc. has launched the 4vs4 real-time strategy game DRAGON BALL GEKISHIN SQUADRA. DRAGON BALL GEKISHIN SQUADRA is Dragon Ball's first team-oriented free-to-play game, where players can fight as the series’ iconic characters in an all-out tactical battle.


◆5 new characters join the fight!
In addition to the 17 heroes that have appeared so far, 5 new heroes will join the fight!

Cell (Perfect Form)／Android 17／Hit／Super Saiyan Kale (Berserk)／Gamma 1 & Gamma 2


[carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138710/b13b3cf559cba792c4855ea03811d71936fa5cf1.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138710/7ad07466a2a17ac352350713a22709eb696cdd71.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138710/9a5b8b691bd94f5dc01ba7f4b146e9c9caa02322.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138710/c8d2cf8fb27849d1ac1c135a660a49a21de1d8cc.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45138710/3e7f786b87df2f4b95ca69ecbc855ee379bf6218.png"][/carousel]

◆What is DRAGON BALL GEKISHIN SQUADRA

[previewyoutube="ojhY1xAAQyc;full"][/previewyoutube]◆ Intense 4 VS 4 Team Battle
Enter the world of Dragon Ball by bringing your favorite characters' earth-shaking strength to the battlefield, and join up with your friends and allies to defeat your opponents and dominate the objectives.

Grow your strength throughout the battle, unlock game-changing skills, and obliterate enemy players and bosses alike.

◆ Heroes With Roles
Pick heroes with unique abilities and skills to fulfill strategic roles for your team:

- DAMAGE: Simple but effective, super aggressive play style with a focus to take down the enemy

- TANK: Persistent and hard to K.O., help your team hold the field and soak up the enemy's attacks

- TECHNICAL: Versatile support, maximize your team's chances by boosting your allies and disrupting the enemy

◆ Customization
Personalize your favorite heroes in your own style with character skins, entrance animations, and special finisher animations.

Find an aesthetic combination that shows off your love for the characters in your own way.


Squad Up with your friends and PLAY NOW!Official Website
